mechanism: Dynamically typed values (tagged in the VM). TypeScript is a separate layer. JS itself checks almost nothing at compile time; failures are TypeError/runtime.
why: The browser required a language that could ship in source and survive sloppy pages.
useWhen: UI, glue, serverless, and anything that must run where only a JS engine exists.
price: Entire classes of bugs move to production; 'undefined is not a function' is the tax.
